items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: I could talk to him, but I don't remember. I don't remember him.

ctx.x: Yeah, I remember Walder Brundy. Well, see, during that time, Walder Brundy, he was up in Cantrell. Cant, Cant, Cant, out of the ground. Well, see, they were real drummers. They could read.
What about, say, John McMurray? Could he read?
